otherFindings.summary: Rails 8.1 deprecates its built-in Sidekiq Active Job adapter (removal planned for 8.2). The replacement needs Sidekiq 7.3.3 or later, whose strict JSON arguments would reject the symbol keys passed to ExportJob.
